title: 73 grams of cocaine, several guns, $13K in cash seized during investigation in Ohio, man arrested - NewsBreak
text:
By Mike Harris ,
9 hours ago
MANSFIELD, OH (WTRF) — A drug investigation in Ohio led to the seizure of suspected cocaine, firearms, cash, and the arrest of one man, according to the METRICH Enforcement Unit.
On April 27, 2026, METRICH detectives, with assistance from the Mansfield Police Department and members of ASORT, executed a drug-related search warrant at a home on Highland Avenue in Mansfield.
During the search, investigators seized about 73 grams of suspected cocaine, two rifles, one handgun, a flare gun, more than $13,000 in cash, and other drug-related evidence.
Authorities arrested Timothy Bush following the search.
Bush faces multiple charges, including trafficking in cocaine, possession of cocaine, and weapons under disability.
Additional drug-related charges are expected to be forwarded to the Richland County Prosecutor’s Office.
The search warrant was authorized through Mansfield Municipal Court.
METRICH officials said the investigation is part of ongoing efforts to target illegal drug distribution in North Central Ohio.
